title: Shane Davis — Back Me Bro launch
radar_signals: ComicsGate Kings closing promotion: six days until Back Me Bro launch
needs: Record the campaign as a project, not a faction.
Track which shows promote it and which people actively participate.
Do not treat promotion alone as proof of personal alliance.

timeline.summary: At the close, Ethan said the launch was approximately six days away and described it as an all-hands-on-deck ComicsGate event, providing direct evidence of ComicsGate Kings functioning as a promotional hub for the campaign.

evidence.note: Closing promotion for Back Me Bro and call for ComicsGate-wide support.
